QUOTE: The empty vector is the same value a legitimately empty input produces, so callers cannot tell "no tokens" from "failed."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states failure is indistinguishable from legitimately empty input, and that most callers don't check (only the MTP path does, as a too-short-prompt check). That is close enough to "no caller checks for it" in substance.
